summary: Layer 1B expanded the AI power-delivery node toward less obvious US-listed electrical infrastructure assets rather than hyperscaler or semiconductor leaders. The strongest near-term evidence clusters around medium-voltage switchgear, custom power systems, data-center electrical contracting, substation/transmission work, and cable-management infrastructure. Powell is included as a reference anchor because its data-center order evidence is unusually explicit; IES Holdings, MYR Group, and Atkore form the underfollowed discovery lane.
